description: This file defines a Presenter class (`HeroMetricsPresenter`) responsible for rendering a composite hero card UI in an Android application. The card displays three circular ring gauges (Active %, Alerts, Energy) and a mini bar strip representing recent activity, with detailed drawing logic implemented in `onBindViewHolder`. It includes an inner data class (`HeroData`) which models the data used for rendering.

classes.name: HeroMetricsPresenter
classes.description: A custom Presenter for displaying a hero card with gauges and recent activity visualization in an Android TV UI.

classes.name: HeroMetricsPresenter.HeroData
classes.description: Data model representing metrics and recent activity data to be visualized by the presenter.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view holder with an ImageCardView, setting size, title, content, and background.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Draws the custom composite hero card image with gauges and bar strip onto a bitmap and assigns it to the ImageCardView.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Cleans up the view by removing the image bitmap when unbinding.
